page_note: Page is dominated by Manichaean ecclesial institution discourse — describing the ideal catechumen who places his trust in the holy church, supports the elect, helps the church with fasting, prayer, almsgiving. Includes a citation of 1 Corinthians 7:29-31 ("those who have a wife, let them be as those who have not...") attributed to "his apostle" (Paul, mediated through Mani's apostolic frame). The page exhibits SIGNIFICANT editorial fatigue (+11.62) with massive ecclesial vocabulary surge in second half (+46.7). No cosmological substrate detected — this is pure institutional/pastoral material from the Manichaean church compilation layer.
